description: This file is a recipe/configuration script for building the Rust package manager 'Cargo' within the Yocto Project build system. It specifies dependencies, setup steps, build instructions, and related metadata for including Cargo in the build.

methods.name: do_cargo_setup_snapshot
methods.description: Sets up the Cargo snapshot environment, runs the install script, and patches the Cargo binary to use the uninative loader if available.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Prepares the environment by setting RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 for Rust compilation.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the Cargo binary into the target image directory.
